# Shrink My Pics

> Shrink My Pics is a free, browser-based image resizer and converter. It resizes images and converts them to WebP, JPG, or PNG entirely client-side using the Canvas API and WebAssembly builds of libwebp and mozjpeg (the same encoders behind Google's Squoosh) — no image is ever uploaded to a server, no signup is required, and there is no watermark or usage limit.

## Tool

- [Shrink My Pics](https://shrinkmypics.com/): Resize images by width/height and convert to WebP, JPG, or PNG, with an optional high-quality WASM compression mode. Supports batch processing of multiple images at once.

## Related

- [Shrink My Tools](https://shrinkmytools.com/): A companion site with 17 more free, browser-based tools — PDF merge/split/compress, QR code generator, JSON formatter, password generator, unit converter, and more.
